_about: NHL equivalency (NHLe) factors: NHL points per game ~= source-league points per game x factor. APPROXIMATE practitioner midpoints (public NHLe work; the published values drift by season and method), not fitted here. Refit later by replacing this file; keys are the NHL landing page's seasonTotals[].leagueAbbrev strings (verified live 2026-09-29). 'class' picks the league-norm age for the age adjustment; 'reliability' (0-1) scales how much a season in that league counts as evidence.

age_adjustment._about: A season played younger than the league's norm age is bumped up by per_year for each year under it (at most max_years): an 18-year-old scoring in a men's league is a better prospect than a 24-year-old with the same line.
